cues: Which carcinogen is linked to hepatocellular carcinoma?
Meet our patient: a terrified liver, studded with tumour nodules.
That's hepatocellular carcinoma, cancer of the liver's main cells.
Polyvinyl chloride, or PVC, leaking toxic fumes.
The real culprit is vinyl chloride, the gas used to make PVC.
Workers in plastics factories breathe it in, year after year.
And the liver pays the price.
High-yield tip: vinyl chloride is the classic cause of hepatic angiosarcoma, and it's also linked to hepatocellular carcinoma.
